questions.text: Away mode lowers the heating target to 17 °C, which conflicts with keeping the house at 22 °C throughout your holiday. Which should take priority: away mode or 22 °C?

explanation: I can’t apply both away mode and a 22 °C target at the same time. The planner reports that the requested 22 °C band is not met over the planning horizon, so I haven’t applied a schedule.

requirements_check.requirement: indoor temperature in the requested bands
